item: NEON vector store assumes allocation alignment
note: Existing get_nested test under Miri, with debug assertions disabled, fails: pointer alignment 8, required 16. Offset modulo four cannot establish Vec<u32> base alignment.

item: Typed tape getters omit container headers from slice lengths
note: All four getters reproduced truncation; [1,2] iterates only 1. Empty containers panic on len(), and nested arrays panic during iteration. count excludes the header.

item: Safe numeric deserialization reads beyond exhausted tape
note: Second u64::deserialize call after reading 1 panics at safer_unchecked.rs:23. Numeric helpers call next_ without checking EOF; release code uses get_unchecked.

item: 128bit plus approximate parsing cannot compile
note: Capped cargo check for 128bit,approx-number-parsing fails: missing static_cast_i128 at approx.rs:339. Macro gates use nonexistent i128, and approx.rs also lacks its import. Nightly all-features check fails likewise.

item: Approximate parsing without SWAR cannot compile
note: Capped cargo check --no-default-features --features approx-number-parsing fails E0432: unconditional imports refer to helpers gated behind swar-number-parsing.

item: big-int-as-float test compares incompatible types
note: cargo test --features big-int-as-float fails E0277 comparing OwnedValue with StaticNode; library-only cargo check passes. Both checks used the lint cap.

item: Huge-integer regression input fits the 128bit range
note: The test uses thirty decimal nines, below u128::MAX. With 128bit it exercises integer parsing rather than overflow-to-float, even after repairing the comparison type.

item: Pretty tuple variants omit closing delimiters
note: Pair(1,2) pretty output ends with } while its array remains open; Empty() ends with [] but lacks the outer }. serde_json rejects both. end() also restores only one indentation level.

item: Unknown-length empty containers serialize incompletely
note: serialize_seq(None).end() returns Ok("[") in compact and pretty modes; pretty serialize_map(None).end() returns Ok("{"). Compact empty maps correctly close. first conflates empty and already closed.

item: Serde visitors do not enforce container consumption
note: from_slice::<((u8,),u8)>([[1,2],3]) returns Ok(((1,),2)), replacing the sibling value. deserialize_tuple ignores requested length and the sequence visitor result is returned without checking consumption.

item: from_slice allegedly accepts a second JSON root
note: true false and 1 2 return TrailingData; {} {} and [] [] also error. Deserializer construction validates the whole document before T::deserialize runs.

item: Exponent narrowing wraps large magnitudes
note: 1e4294967296 and 1e-4294967296 both parse as 1.0; neighboring exponents produce 10.0 and 0.1. The accumulated i64 exponent is cast to i32 without range validation.

item: Slow numeric returns bypass terminator validation
note: Accepted 1234567890123456789x, its array form, 12345678901234567890.0x and a long fractional token ending x. [123x] correctly errors. Large-integer and slow-float returns precede delimiter checking.

item: Missing low-surrogate escape becomes NUL
note: "\ud800" parses as NUL and "\ud800x" as NUL followed by x. Missing second escape returns Ok((0,6)) instead of an error.

item: Second surrogate lacks an upper-bound check
note: "\ud800\ue000" parses as U+10400 and "\udbff\uffff" as U+10FFFF. Valid minimum/maximum pairs pass. checked_sub rejects values below DC00 but accepts values above DFFF.

item: Consuming DOM conversion rejects numeric object keys
note: Owned and borrowed consuming conversions of {"42":"ok"} to BTreeMap<u32,String> fail with expected u32; both reference conversions succeed. Consuming ObjectAccess uses an ordinary string-value deserializer.

item: BorrowedValue Serde map keys lack an owned fallback
note: serde_json deserialization with an escaped key and deserialization from an owned serde_json::Value object both fail expecting a borrowed string. visit_map requests &str despite supporting owned string storage.

item: Tape scalar methods lose wide integers
note: With 128bit, tape U128(18446744073709551616) yields None from as_u128, and I128(-9223372036854775809) yields None from as_i128. Equivalent DOM access succeeds; tape inherits narrower default methods.

item: Tape conversion tests exercise StaticNode instead of tape values
note: The test module aliases StaticNode as Value; conversions_i128 and conversions_u128 construct that alias. Their assertions cannot detect missing tape scalar forwarding.

item: Lazy equality changes solely after representation upgrade
note: Equal clones of {"a":1} compare unequal after as_object_mut() on one without changing entries. Derived PartialEq distinguishes Tape and Value variants even though contents agree.

item: Strict checks fail on the newer supplied compiler
note: Reproduced three unused-import errors and manual_is_multiple_of in uncapped Clippy. Capped default tests pass (464 tests). This is the supplied Rust 1.99.1 compatibility limit; Rust 1.88 was not tested.

item: Lint allows lack reason attributes
note: Independent advisory Clippy found 69 distinct allow locations without reason attributes. This is lint-policy housekeeping, not a demonstrated behavior defect.

item: Unsafe operations lack recognized local safety comments
note: Advisory Clippy reproduces many missing safety-comment diagnostics, including two unsafe implementations. Mechanical recognition and expanded-location counts do not establish additional correctness defects.

item: Public container and buffer types lack Debug
note: Independent advisory Clippy identifies 13 public types, including Buffers, views and iterators. Adding Debug is public-API style and diagnostic convenience.

item: Long decimal values depend on their byte offset
note: After 64 spaces, 1.2345678901234567890123456789 becomes 5.097733592125637e-10 instead of 1.2345678901234567. Reproduced with default and 128bit features. start_digits stores an ASCII byte instead of a position.

item: Nonfinite floats serialize as invented numeric text
note: Compact, pretty and DOM encoding turn NaN into 2.696539702293474e308 and infinity into 1.797693134862316e308. They pass nonfinite values to ryu format_finite without validation.

item: Serde float deserialization omits 128-bit integer nodes
note: With 128bit, from_slice::<f64>(18446744073709551616) returns ExpectedFloat although the value is exactly representable. parse_double matches only F64, I64 and U64; f32 shares this path.

item: Malformed literals are classified as data errors
note: falsex, truex and nullx error with ExpectedFalse/True/Null, but is_syntax() is false and is_data() true. This contradicts the documented syntax/data classification for malformed JSON.

item: Unexpected error equality is not reflexive
note: Unexpected(Some(String),Some(Bool)) compares unequal to itself. PartialEq omits Unexpected and falls through to false even for identical payloads.

item: Signed integer map keys allegedly fail public round trips
note: {"-12":7,"5":8} successfully deserializes to BTreeMap<i32,u8> and round-trips. The integer-specific methods at lines 515-522 parse keys; deserialize_any string dispatch is not used for i32.

item: Reused Buffers allegedly retain old structural offsets
note: A longer object followed by [], {}, true and [] all parse correctly with the same Buffers. _find_structural_bits clears structural_indexes at lib.rs:890 before filling it.

item: u8 deserialization allegedly wraps out-of-range input
note: 256 and -1 both return ExpectedUnsigned; 255 and 0 succeed. StaticNode uses ValueAsScalar::as_u8, whose try_into conversion checks the range.

item: Tape indexing allegedly counts nested children as siblings
note: For [10,[20,30],40], get(2) returns 40. Node::count at tape.rs:171 returns the complete descendant span plus header, rather than logical element length.

item: Escaped-object aliasing observation depends on Miri model
note: Reproduced a Stacked Borrows retag failure on ordinary object parsing. In a scratch copy using unaligned stores to isolate it, Tree Borrows passes. Experimental-model disagreement leaves a language-level defect unsettled.
